**Totals**: 222 certificates over 206 tasks (s_load_store carries 2 per task); fixture produce 55.3 ms + check 194.8 ms; chain sidecars 206 produced in 19.2 ms, checked in 117.4 ms; whole sweep 387.3 ms wall.

Benchmark semantics anchor: the upstream EBMC-generated SMV models carry NO INIT constraint (verified 2026-07-21 against the pin commit's NeurIPS24/Benchmarks/SMV files), so every task is a from-every-state claim over demonic inputs — the universal form these certificates prove. Their published completions on this class (their own plot_cmp.py arrays, timeout 18000 s): our-'25-MILP 190/206, nuXmv-BDD 206/206, ABC 206/206, rIC3 196/206. House: 206/206 certified, with checkable artifacts.

Measurement rider: walls measured on a GB10 (aarch64), CPython 3.12, single thread, time.perf_counter. Certificates certify the pinned benchmark tree's .sv files (`neuralmc-pin/`, upstream `f2bd71c`). Trust ledger: consuming lemma `SafetyDemonic.lean` (machine-checked; build exit 0); the chain rules used by this class (`xg_shift`, `two_step_chain`) machine-checked as twins in BOTH provers — Lean (`TemporalRewrite.lean`) and HOL4 (`ltl_rewriteScript.sml`; build GREEN); standalone checkers `ck_safety.py` (ledger K0–K5) + `ck_specchain.py` (safety units); trust-seam narrowing `groundtruth_safety.py` (independent re-transcription; exhaustive on the smallest instance per family, sampled on the largest, monitor outputs included); adversarial battery `mutants_safety.py` (3 positive controls + 8 fixture-layer + 5 chain-layer mutants, each refused at the attacked layer).
